reading.body:
Aligned Data Center Chicago ORD-01 is a Tier III designed facility on an 18.5 acre site in Northlake, Illinois, qualifying it to host continuous-availability workloads. The operator has earned a 3 Green Globes New Construction certification, the first in Illinois under that standard. No IT capacity, total power consumption, or square footage is published for this building.

The facility's capacity is not disclosed, making its scale relative to the region impossible to establish from published data. Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities and 236 MW of published operational and planned capacity across six facilities that disclose their figures. Northlake hosts one of those disclosed sites. The operator Aligned operates 50 campuses with over 5 GW announced capacity nationwide and in Latin America.

ORD-01 sits on property adjacent to Chicago's O'Hare International Airport, which constrains available land and drives electrical interconnection toward municipal rather than rural power districts. The unpublished capacity makes it impossible to read whether this campus matters to AI compute scaling at regional or national scale. Alignment decisions for this site rest on facts the operator has chosen not to release.
